## How it works

The skill searches **7 verified GitHub repositories** (including Anthropic's official skills repo, Vercel Labs, obra/superpowers with 33k+ stars, and several curated community lists) using keyword matching against skill names and descriptions. It supports three access tiers:

| Priority | Method | Rate Limit |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | GitHub Connector (enabled in settings) | 15,000 req/hr — real-time |
| 2 | Offline cache | Unlimited — instant fallback |
| 3 | `GITHUB_TOKEN` env var | 5,000 req/hr |

You can also run a **deep dive** on any specific skill to pull its full `SKILL.md` content before deciding to import it — as demonstrated above with `systematic-debugging` and `scientific-writing`. If no match is found, the skill automatically suggests using `/skill-creator` to build a custom one.
